title.narrative: Strengthening Global South Leadership in the multilateral UN processes on Sexual Rights 2022-2024

description.narrative: The project is a 1.5-year engagement with the Sexual Rights Initiative, earmarked for capacity building activities for SRHR advocates in developing countries. The key objective of the project is to ensure stronger protection and promotion of sexual and reproductive health and rights, including through building capacity of national SRHR advocates to effectively engage with the international human rights system to hold their governments accountable for implementing their SRHR obligations domestically and the advancement of universal human rights standards related to SRHR.

title.narrative: Feminists and advocates working on diverse and neglected SRHR concerns have the knowledge, skills and tools to effectively engage in the Geneva based UN human rights system.

actual.value: 255 SRHR advocates from DAC ODA eligible countries supported by SRI actively engaged in special procedures, treaty body, UPR and HRC sessions to hold their governments accountable for SRHR.
